summary: Iteration 223 — Deck Reattivo + FULL COLOR RECOLOR regression. Backend: 4/4 pytest passed (gate PIN 198505 unlocks with cookie+level=master; admin login; /api/deck/status shape valid with all 4 depts & critical_stations; end-to-end reactivity — creating a live shift on Panificio flips depts.panificio.active>=1, then PUT /api/lab/shift-state {machines_down:[Forno Pizzeria]} correctly flips mood='critico' with populated critical_stations; cleanup done). Frontend: gate unlock + admin login via API, page loads with orange industrial palette (buttons show rgb(255,107,0) and rgb(255,157,66), no cyan residue). deck-multiverse, deck-heartbeat ('52 BPM · CALM'), all 4 deck-dept chips (panificio/pizzeria/pasticceria/banco), master-console, panel-mike-alerts, panel-mohamed-inbox, panel-living-recipe, panel-emergency all present. Clicking deck-dept-panificio works with no error. No horizontal overflow on 1920 desktop nor 390 mobile (scrollWidth===clientWidth). No JS runtime pageerrors; only benign WebGL perf warnings from the 3D scene and 2 expected 401s before the gate cookie was set on the pre-nav request.

issues: Mood label shows English 'CALM' when browser locale is en; Italian would say 'sereno'. Cosmetic i18n only (pre-existing pattern, not caused by recolor).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>7k lines with multiple loops like _deck_alarm_loop mixed in); consider splitting deck/status + alarm loop into a dedicated module for maintainability.
Shift model uses HH:MM strings + separate 'day' field — fine but easy to submit wrong isoformat (as encountered here). Consider stricter Pydantic docs/examples so consumers don't break.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 1 shift (TEST_DeckOp / Panificio) and set machines_down; both cleaned up in test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/shifts payload requires fields: employee, role, station, day (YYYY-MM-DD), start & end as HH:MM strings (max_length=5) — NOT isoformat. Gate must be established before login (verify sets httpOnly cookie mikilab_gate). Deck polling on frontend hits /api/deck/status every 15s and works fine. To skip Tablet-Mode popup during automation, set localStorage mikilab_kiosk_hint=1 and mikilab_briefing_seen=1 BEFORE reload.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found post-recolor. Deck reactivity semantics intact, orange industrial palette applied consistently, no overflow, no runtime errors.
